stories.title: St. Johns County sees record-breaking sea turtle nesting season with 1,483 nests
stories.summary: County officials said one nest belonged to a Kemp's ridley sea turtle, which is considered the rarest and most endangered sea turtle species in the world.

stories.title: Jacksonville sexual predator arrested on new child sexual abuse material charge
stories.summary: David White, a Jacksonville resident and registered sexual predator, faces a first-degree felony charge for allegedly possessing child sexual abuse material.

stories.title: 8-year-old child killed, two adults injured in crash on Oakleaf Plantation Parkway: JSO
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office said four people were taken to hospitals after the SUV hit a tree Sunday afternoon. A 7-week-old baby appeared to be uninjured.

stories.title: 'Hard to find the words': Wicked Barley Brewing Company to close after a decade of operations
stories.summary: The beloved local brewery in Goodby's Creek first opened its doors in 2016.

stories.title: Jacksonville turkey giveaway serves 450 families ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Icemen and Jacksonville Waves teamed up with Campione Law and North Florida Medical Center to hand out free turkeys on Sunday.

stories.title: Florida state offices add these 4 holiday closure dates. What to know
stories.summary: State offices will be closed on Nov. 25, Dec. 23, Dec. 24, and Dec. 31 for the holiday season.

stories.title: Light-Up! Night draws 'nice' crowd after 'naughty' weather put the tradition in jeopardy
stories.summary: The ceremony to flip the switch on Night of Lights saw its typical crowd fill the Plaza de la Constitucion despite concerns weather would interfere.

stories.title: 19-year-old reported missing in Jacksonville found safe
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says that the man was last seen at around 7 a.m. leaving his home on Lake Park Court.

stories.title: Person killed in early-morning house fire outside of Macclenny, officials say
stories.summary: The Baker County Fire Rescue says that first responders arrived in the area around 1:30 a.m.

stories.title: ‘He lit up the room’: Bradford community remembers teacher, coach and chaplain Robbie Best
stories.summary: From prayers before games to smiles at the school gate, students and families share how Robbie Best made them feel seen, encouraged and loved.

stories.title: Jacksonville woman charged with animal cruelty after three dead dogs found in hotel room
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says officers responded after hotel management had been notified of a "noxious and unpleasant" smell.

stories.title: 'Something you should take seriously': Putnam County braces for weeks of flooding
stories.summary: Putnam County braces for major flooding as rising St. Johns River water threatens homes and roads. Residents are urged to prepare and avoid flooded roads.
